title: Cryptic padlock from a 400-year-old shipwreck finally opened ‪—‬ but it leaves a mystery
caption:
After 400 years under the sea, this Elizabethan padlock has finally been opened. Researchers used medical imaging to uncover its secret code.

Source: Livescience - Cryptic padlock from a 400-year-old shipwreck finally opened ‪—‬ but it leaves a mystery

https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/cryptic-padlock-from-a-400-year-old-shipwreck-finally-opened-but-it-leaves-a-mystery
